newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Motors to post appraisal loss 43.1 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Motors to post appraisal loss 43.1 bln yen.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Friday it would post an appraisal loss of 43.1 billion yen on its securities holdings in the year to March 1997.

The appraisal loss came from shares owned by California-based Mitsubishi Motors Sales of America Inc (MMSA) which is 96.3 percent owned by Mitsubishi Motors. Unlisted MMSA has cumulative losses, but Mitsubishi Motors did not disclose the size of the loss.
Mitsubishi Motors will announce its 1996/97 business result on May 29.

As a result of the appraisal loss, Mitsubishi revised downward its forecast of parent net profit to 15 billion yen in 1996/97 from a November forecast of 21 billion yen, against an actual 20.47 billion yen a year earlier.
But it also said its parent current profit in 1996/97 is expected to rise to a record 58 billion yen, up from the previous record 55.39 billion yen in 1995/96, helped by cost-cutting and a weak yen.
MMSA has been trying to improve its poor financial condition, caused by its poor sales in the United States.
Mitsubishi said MMSA plans to cut sales costs, launch new models and increase its capital spending to improve performance.
